definition.description: Troops place Dream Marks on targets every two turns, dealing extra Lancer damage once next turn

entry.description: Ambusher capture over 10 battles. MiniClaw2 attacks with Logan 1/0/0 and Renee 1/0/0 using 6000 T9 Infantry and 1500 T9 Lancers. [LAB]MiniClaw defends with Logan 1/1/0 and Patrick 1/1 using 5000 T6 Infantry and 5000 T6 Marksmen. Stats are the displayed battle-report bonuses; per-trial skill counts and troop outcomes are retained in metadata.

data_quality_notes: Trial 2's supplied attacker troop survivors sum to 590 (9 Infantry + 581 Lancers), while its supplied attacker total is 581.
Trial 2's supplied defender troop survivors sum to 0, while its supplied defender total is 9. Values are preserved exactly as supplied.

entry.description: WIP attacks minxxx with attacker heroes Hector 2/3/2, Renee 3/3/3, and Wayne 2/2/2. Attacker fields 1700 infantry_t6 only; defender has no heroes and fields 300 infantry_t6 only. Game report result: attacker 1597 survivors, defender wiped.

Deterministic Renee/Ahmose damage-taken bucket overlap discriminator frozen before capture. minxxx attacks WIP with Ahmose 1/1/3 and Renee 4/4/4, fielding 4000 T6 Infantry plus 500 T6 Lancers into 13400 T6 Infantry. Infantry attacks before Lancers; Blade of Light contributes 15% active.hero.damageTaken.up to the shared target before every eligible Renee marked Lancer attack. Using current account stats, Renee sharing active.hero.damageTaken.up with Ahmose predicts minxxx wins with 3757-3759 total survivors; Renee in a separate numerator bucket predicts 3809-3811. Both candidates leave all 500 Lancers and more than 3200 Ahmose Infantry alive, so the target dies first. Capture exact report stats, then rerun these unchanged candidate mechanics before interpreting the observation.

Deterministic Renee/Charge bucket discriminator frozen before capture. WIP attacks minxxx with Renee 3/3/3, fielding 500 T6 Lancers into 1490 T6 Marksmen. Charge contributes 10% in type.single_target.damage.up on every Lancer-to-Marksman job. Using stats from the preceding Renee/Gwen capture, Renee in active.hero.damageTaken.up predicts WIP wins with about 52 Lancers because Charge and Renee multiply across buckets; Renee in type.single_target.damage.up predicts minxxx wins with about 49 Marksmen because Charge and Renee add within one bucket. Capture exact report stats, then rerun these unchanged candidate mechanics before interpreting the observation.

Second deterministic Renee/Gwen grouping discriminator. WIP attacks with Renee 3/3/3 and Gwen 2/1/0, fielding 500 T6 Lancers into minxxx's 900 T6 Infantry. Using the exact stats from the preceding 620-vs-920 report, separate Renee/Gwen buckets with Gwen's stated 10% predict 330 survivors; same bucket at 10% or separate buckets at an effective 5% predict 321; same bucket at an effective 5% predicts 316; and no effective Gwen S1 predicts 312. Corresponding approximate Renee S1 activation counts are 25, 26, 27, and 28. These candidates and the decision rule are frozen before capture; the report's exact captured stats will be substituted afterward without changing the candidate models.

Deterministic Renee Defense Down bucket discriminator. minxxx attacks with Renee and Hendrik, fielding 120 T6 lancers into WIP's 446 T9 infantry. Hendrik's only unlocked expedition skill is persistent 5% Defense Down. Using estimated current stats reconstructed from recent reports, homogeneous Renee Defense Down predicts WIP wins with about 34 infantry; homogeneous Health Down or Damage Taken Up predicts minxxx wins with about 5 lancers. The candidate configurations and comparison rule are frozen before capture; exact captured stats will be inserted into those unchanged candidates after the report.

Renee solo defender test. WIP attacking no heroes ~450/360/450 t6, minxxx defending with Renee (4/4/4). Tests S1 (Nightmare Trace: lancer DamageUp every 2 turns), S2 (Dreamcatcher: lancer DamageUp every 2 turns), S3 (Dreamslice: OppDefenseDown all every 2 turns). All skills deterministic, no RNG.

XxWIPxX attacks Piddilyminxxx with Renee 3/3/3 and Wayne 3/3/3. Attacker fields 170 infantry_t6, 150 lancer_t6, and 190 marksman_t6; defender has no heroes and fields 888 infantry_t6. Game report result: attacker 427 survivors, defender wiped. Skill details report Renee triggers 20/1/1 with no listed kills, and Wayne triggers 30/20/19 with 23/-/33 listed kills.

Deterministic Renee S1 damage-kind discriminator. minxxx attacks with Renee 4/4/4 and 1500 T6 Lancers into WIP's Wu Ming 3/3/3 and 4000 T6 Infantry. Wu Ming S1 reduces normal damage to Infantry by 15% and skill damage by 18%. Before capture, the central predictions were: unaffected extra damage +430 with 47 Nightmare Trace activations, normal damage +360 with 51 activations, and skill damage +347 with 52 activations. The game returned +359 with 51 activations. A 2000-sample +/-0.05 displayed-stat probe produced +429-431/47 for unaffected extra, +359-361/51 for normal, and +346-349/51-52 for skill; the exact observation occurred 487 times under normal and never under either alternative.

No-hero 100-lancer control for the Renee lancer-source response sweep. WIP attacks 1000/800/1000 T6; minxxx defends 200 infantry, 100 lancers, and 101 marksmen T6. Total defender army remains 401 across the zero/one/100-lancer sweep.

Renee 4/4/4 100-lancer response fixture paired with renee_kind_100_lancer_control_nc and the zero/25-lancer pairs. WIP attacks 1000/800/1000 T6; minxxx defends with Renee, 200 infantry, 100 lancers, and 101 marksmen T6. The simulator candidates are compared using the exact sqrt(troops[unit])*sqrt(min_army) term. Fixed full kit, deterministic.

No-hero 25-lancer control for the Renee lancer-source response sweep. WIP attacks 1000/800/1000 T6; minxxx defends 200 infantry, 25 lancers, and 176 marksmen T6. Total defender army remains 401 across the zero/25/100-lancer sweep.

Renee 4/4/4 25-lancer response fixture paired with renee_kind_25_lancer_control_nc and the zero/100-lancer pairs. WIP attacks 1000/800/1000 T6; minxxx defends with Renee, 200 infantry, 25 lancers, and 176 marksmen T6. Candidate predictions use the exact sqrt(troops[unit])*sqrt(min_army) term; no assumption is made that a small lancer body contributes linearly. Fixed full kit, deterministic.

Renee 4/4/4 control for the Edith damage-up interaction anchor. WIP attacks with 3000 T6 infantry; minxxx defends with Renee and 100 T6 lancers. Pair with renee_kind_s1_damage_up_anchor_edith_nc. Fixed full kit, deterministic.

Renee 4/4/4 plus Edith 3/3/3 interaction anchor for Renee S1. WIP attacks with 3000 T6 infantry; minxxx defends with Renee, Edith, and 100 T6 lancers. Edith S1/2 is emulator-verified active.hero.damage.up for lancers. Using the captured report stats, all-extra-attack Renee predicts about +2705 remaining while changing Renee S1 to active.hero.damage.up predicts about +2715; the game gives +2703. Pair with renee_kind_s1_damage_up_anchor_control_nc. Fixed full kits, deterministic.

No-hero zero-lancer control for the Renee lancer-source gating sweep. WIP attacks 1000/800/1000 T6; minxxx defends 200 infantry and 201 marksmen T6. Total defender army remains 401 across the zero/one/100-lancer sweep.

Renee 4/4/4 zero-lancer gating fixture paired with renee_kind_zero_lancer_control_nc. WIP attacks 1000/800/1000 T6; minxxx defends with Renee, 200 infantry, and 201 marksmen T6. With no lancer source, Renee's three turn-triggered skills should not activate; this checks that hero presence alone does not create the measured effect. Fixed full kit, deterministic.

Renee 4/4/4 + Ahmose 1/1/3 all-same mechanic discriminator. WIP attacks 5000 T6 Marksmen with no heroes; minxxx defends 300 T6 Infantry and 100 T6 Lancers with Ahmose and Renee. Ahmose's deterministic BladeOfLight damage-taken-up makes TTT predict +2017 survivors versus +1687 to +1711 for every other all-same hypothesis. Deterministic.

Renee 4/4/4 + Ahmose 1/1/3 strong all-same damage-taken-up discriminator, designed from the exact stats captured in the first Ahmose report. WIP attacks with 10000 T6 Marksmen and no heroes; minxxx defends 300 T6 Infantry and 500 T6 Lancers with Ahmose and Renee. Same-bucket TTT predicts +3301 survivors versus +2499 to +2530 for every other all-same hypothesis. Deterministic.

Renee 4/4/4 + Edith 3/3/3 all-same mechanic discriminator. WIP attacks 8000 T6 Marksmen with no heroes; minxxx defends 500 T6 Lancers with Renee and Edith. Edith's verified Lancer active.hero.damage.up makes UUU predict +5136 survivors versus +4916 for every other all-same hypothesis. Deterministic.

Renee 5/5/5 + Hendrik 5/5/5 final all-same defense-down discriminator. The run-testcase capture rejected the requested 60000 T9 Marksmen because the verified march-capacity deployment was 57400; this entry preserves that same deterministic battle from the immediately re-read war report rather than repeating it.

Renee 4/4/4 + Jasser 4/4 all-same mechanic discriminator. WIP attacks 8000 T6 Marksmen with no heroes; minxxx defends 800 T6 Lancers with Renee and Jasser. Jasser's verified active.hero.lethality.up makes LLL predict +2033 survivors versus +867 for every other all-same hypothesis. Deterministic.

Renee 4/4/4 + Seo-yoon 3/3 all-same mechanic discriminator. WIP attacks 8000 T6 Marksmen with no heroes; minxxx defends 800 T6 Lancers with Renee and Seo-yoon. Seo-yoon's verified active.hero.attack.up makes AAA predict +2187 survivors versus +1400 for every other all-same hypothesis. Deterministic.

Renee 4/4/4 + Wu Ming 3/3/2 all-same mechanic discriminator. WIP attacks 8000 T6 Marksmen with no heroes; minxxx defends 800 T6 Lancers with Renee and Wu Ming. Wu Ming's verified skill-damage-up makes EEE predict +1039 survivors versus +1696 for ordinary non-U modifiers and +2285 for UUU. Deterministic.
